meta.source: https://1337.partners/en — computed styles and stylesheet rules, measured 2026-10-22 at 1440px wide

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm off-white, never pure white.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Window and panel surfaces that sit on paper (the site's --win).

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Quiet alternate section background (the site's --paper-2).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, primary text, 1.5px and 2px rules, solid buttons.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Body paragraphs, lead text, nav links.

tokens.name: ink-mute
tokens.usage: Descriptions and secondary copy.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Captions, step numbers, logo words. Smallest text that still passes 4.5:1 on paper.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairline dividers between rows and cells. The sticky nav uses a lighter rgba(17,17,17,0.05).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Opaque borders on panels and inputs.

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: The one accent: selected pills, accent copy, live dots, nav underline. Use sparingly.

tokens.name: purple-light
tokens.usage: Arrows and small glyphs next to purple; not for body text on paper (3:1 only).

tokens.name: purple-deep
tokens.usage: Text on purple-soft fills.

tokens.name: purple-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fills behind purple-deep text; the 'leet flash' highlight.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Signal only: the blinking block cursor, the 'now' marker, counters. Fails as text on paper (2.5:1), so never use it for words.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Full-width dark sections (warm stone, not black). Always with the grain overlay; see README.

tokens.name: on-band
tokens.usage: Serif headlines on band.

tokens.name: on-band-mute
tokens.usage: Body copy on band.

tokens.name: on-band-tag
tokens.usage: Mono section tags on band.

tokens.name: purple-on-band
tokens.usage: Tag square and highlighted words on band (purple at full strength is too dark there).

tokens.name: band-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card outlines on band.

tokens.name: disk-ink
tokens.usage: The black floppy-disk card.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on purple fills (selected pill).

styles.name: display-hero
styles.sample: Enterprise AI platform for regulated companies.
styles.usage: The h1. Fluid: 40px on phones (390 wide), about 79px at 1280, 89px at 1440.

styles.name: display-section
styles.sample: One AI platform for the whole company.
styles.usage: Section h2, often on band. 36px on phones.

styles.name: display-sub
styles.usage: Smaller h2 beside a tag ('Who we work with.'), job titles. 24px on phones.

styles.name: display-card
styles.sample: We find where AI pays off most.
styles.usage: h3 in step and card grids.

styles.name: text-lead
styles.sample: Powering safe AI workflows for regulated teams.
styles.usage: Hero subline in ink-soft. 16px on phones.

styles.name: text-large
styles.sample: We train teams on their own use cases.
styles.usage: Body on band and in feature cells.

styles.name: text-body
styles.sample: That is why the platform comes with the people.

styles.name: text-link
styles.usage: Inline action links: purple, with a 1px purple border-bottom and 1px padding-bottom instead of text-decoration.

styles.name: text-table
styles.usage: Table cells; 600 for the first column.

styles.name: mono-label
styles.usage: Nav links and section tags, always uppercase. A section tag is ink with a 9px purple square before it and a 10px gap.

styles.name: mono-window
styles.usage: Window title bars and in-window text.

styles.name: mono-tiny
styles.usage: Column heads inside windows, in muted, uppercase.

styles.name: ui-heading
styles.usage: Only inside product screenshots and mock screens.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside pills and rails.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row inner padding; icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Small stack gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Column gap in tables and grids.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap after a 2px top rule.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large grid gap (clamped 24px to 56px).

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Section padding: 74px × the site's --pad of 1.35.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: The default. Buttons, cards, sections and tables are square.

tokens.name: radius-hair
tokens.usage: Barely softened bar ends.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Floating toggles.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Product mock screens only (10px to 14px on the site).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pill tabs.

tokens.name: wrap
tokens.usage: Max content width.

tokens.name: wide
tokens.usage: Max width for wide grids.

tokens.name: rule-hair
tokens.usage: Divider weight in line.

tokens.name: rule-mid
tokens.usage: Outlined controls and window frames in ink.

tokens.name: rule-top
tokens.usage: Top rule over a quote or a tab, in ink.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Sticky nav: paper at 90% opacity with backdrop blur(10px).

tokens.name: disk-notch
tokens.usage: Chamfered top-right corner of floppy cards (clip-path).

tokens.name: tag-square
tokens.usage: The purple square before a section tag.

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Table row hover.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Color and background changes on buttons and links.

tokens.name: dur-quick
tokens.usage: Opacity fades on photos and meta.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Button lift (transform + box-shadow).

tokens.name: dur-swap
tokens.usage: Tab panel and quote swaps; theme change on body.

tokens.name: dur-reveal
tokens.usage: Scroll reveal (opacity + 18px rise).

tokens.name: dur-draw
tokens.usage: Bar charts growing; stagger 0.1s per bar.

tokens.name: dur-line
tokens.usage: SVG line draw (stroke-dashoffset); sparklines 1.4s.

tokens.name: dur-load
tokens.usage: Stepped loaders: steps(19).

tokens.name: dur-marquee
tokens.usage: Logo marquee, linear, infinite, paused on hover.

tokens.name: ease-1337
tokens.usage: The site's --ease. Fast start, long soft landing. Every transform uses it.

tokens.name: ease-plain
tokens.usage: Color, opacity and the scroll reveal.

tokens.name: ease-blink
tokens.usage: Cursor and live-dot blinking.

tokens.name: ease-load
tokens.usage: Loader bars and dial reveals.

shadow.note: No soft drop shadows on page elements. Depth comes from hard, offset, ink-coloured blocks, as on a 1990s desktop.

tokens.name: shadow-hard-sm
tokens.usage: Small offset block: chips, small windows.

tokens.name: shadow-hard
tokens.usage: Retro windows (with a 1px ink border).

tokens.name: shadow-hard-lg
tokens.usage: Large feature windows and photo frames.

tokens.name: shadow-ring
tokens.usage: Outlined (ghost) buttons and the language switch: an inset ring instead of a border.

tokens.name: shadow-ring-band
tokens.usage: Ghost buttons on band.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Only under the rounded product mock screen; the one soft shadow on the site.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Chips inside the product mock.
